## Projectiles and skill objects

**Feature status: PARTIAL.**

Client/server projectile spawn, hit, update, despawn and spawned skill objects.

**Current implementation**

- Client-driven player projectiles (catalog isServerDriven=false: staff fireballs, bows, crossbows, thrown axes and the other player projectile skills) are confirmed from PC2S_ExecuteSpawnProjectileSkillEffectReq: the server echoes PS2C_SpawnProjectileNoti under the client's own instance, skill instance, effect unique id, fire position, destination, direction and request tick, and no longer announces a second server-numbered copy of the same flight.
- A refused client spawn report (no matching action, launch point more than 5 m from the caster, more flights than maxSpawnCount, reused or invalid instance) is answered with one PS2C_SpawnClientProjectileFailNoti per named flight.
- Server timers still own every hit: a confirmed flight aimed at a live monster lands at the deadline computed from the fire position, target position and catalog speed. PC2S_ClientProjectileHitReq and PC2S_UpdateProjectileReq are ignored without consuming the request budget.
- PC2S_DespawnClientProjectileReq is echoed once as PS2C_DespawnProjectileNoti for a flight the client launched; a reported miss (any reason except HitTarget) withdraws that flight's pending hit. Unknown or repeated reports are ignored.
- Projectile hits send DamageNoti with the flight instance_id and EX5SkillEffectOriginType_Projectile, then PS2C_ProjectileHitNoti; server-driven flights (monster projectiles) then send DespawnProjectileNoti with reason HitTarget and hit_unit_id, or LifeTime when the target died in flight.
- Server-driven flights launch from the effect's catalog spawn offset rotated by the caster yaw (Candidate) and use instance IDs from 0x40000000 upward, so they never share the client's (caster, instance) key with a client flight.
- Free-aim player flights can select the nearest live enemy whose authored hit capsule crosses the aimed segment within catalog speed/lifetime. Linear flights cannot select an off-path reported target and check impact occupancy; homing locks retain their distinct path. This bounded launch-snapshot model is not full moving-world physics.
- Client projectile events are single-use per cast/stage/unique event, with maxSpawnCount and bounded instance tracking. Early reports cannot accelerate the authored event deadline. Server spawns retain effect_unique_id and damage retains skill_effect_unique_id.
- Cylinder and oriented-box interval areas can hit on successive pulses despite overlap groups, spawn at an authored main target and expire/remove once. Shape-based projectile hit effects select around impact rather than the caster.
- Caster-anchored areas (EX5TargetingPosType_Caster) are placed at the caster's current position moved by targetingPurpose.offsetX/offsetY catalog centimetres in the cast-yaw frame (X forward, Y right), sharing the projectile launch-offset helper. The 42 offset-bearing area effects include the ElementalStaff lightning line 2266 (five strikes 2.5-12.5 m ahead) and the CurvedSword dummy area 211804; previously every such area spawned under the caster.
- A projectile's SkillObject FK_hitTargetDespawnSkillEffect runs where the flight lands, so the poison bottle leaves its SkillObject 100302 cloud (10 s, a hit every second); spawnAreaOfEffect names a SkillObject row directly (79 exported areas, the item balms included) and the area's interval effect carries its FK_statusEffectId debuff. Area unit ids use type nibble 3; announcement, hit naming, LifeTime despawn and removal 1496 ms later follow the captured official cloud (docs/item-effects.md).
- ClientProjectileHitReq (20021) and UpdateProjectileReq (20023) are validated for action and projectile ownership, timing, the authored trajectory envelope and duplicates, under a separate 256-per-second report budget. Updates publish UpdateProjectileNoti (46) with the server-calculated destination or lost state; a client hit is confirmation only and server deadlines still own hits and damage. Targetless projectiles keep bounded lifetime state.
- Area lifetime-end hits (2026-10-30): SkillObject.FK_lifeTimeDespawnSkillEffect is exported as despawn_effect_id (18 exported areas, e.g. Lightning Storm 160501 -> 160212, Meteor 160502 -> 160245, curved-sword wave 4001 and 15 monster areas) and applied at the area's end tick with the area unit as caster, its own shape around the area selecting targets, ahead of the LifeTime DespawnSkillObjectNoti. Previously these areas dealt no damage. The active-area bound rose from 16 to 128 so one 25-bolt storm (2235/2296/2254) is not truncated; NPC area attacks whose only damage is a lifetime-end hit count as offensive.
- Elemental Staff audit (2026-10-30): player MainTarget and Aim areas no longer fall back to the caster. A MainTarget area uses its live cast target; otherwise (and every Aim area) the event waits up to 300 ms (Candidate) for the client's PC2S_ExecuteSkillEffectReq, whose first reported target or aim_position within skill range + 5 m places it, and the area appears at that moment; without a report it lands ahead at the skill range (Candidate). Affects the fire/lightning bursts 2274/2275/2280-2290/2604-2619, fire wall 2224/2295, meteor 2268, chain thunderbolt 2271 and rain of fire 2628. Projectiles export SkillObject.FK_projectileHitConditionalSkillEffect as conditional_hit (11 projectiles); the runtime picks the first branch whose maxHPRatio/statusEffectStack conditions hold for the struck unit, else the default. Server-driven piercing player flights (isPenetration, e.g. stitching burn 2611/160560) strike every enemy crossing their path up to maxTargetCount; previously 2611 dealt no damage.
- Aimed and expiring flights (2026-10-30): spawnProjectile effects export their placement purpose; a server-driven player flight with Aim placement (Dragon's Roar 11130, aimed at the prepare stage's ground marker) waits up to 300 ms for the client's ExecuteSkillEffectReq and flies to its aim_position (within skill range + 5 m) without homing, clamped where its lifetime ends (speed x duration). Projectiles export FK_lifeTimeDespawnSkillEffect as lifetime_despawn_effects; a server-driven flight that ends without striking a unit applies them at its end point (19 flights in use, all authoring the same effect for hit and lifetime). Areas left by a flight stay on the struck unit or the impact point. Placement sources (cast_target, reported_target, reported_aim, range_fallback) and aimed-flight sources are logged for live checks.
- Outstanding-projectile immunity retention (2026-11-02): ending or changing a player action retains its elapsed Dodge, Damage and reaction immunity on already outstanding flights for their own impact deadlines. Cancellation and stage retirement win at the exact cutoff; authored stage duration bounds the lifetime. Immediate chained effects use the retained immunity, but new secondary flights do not inherit it. A newer action cannot grant immunity to an earlier impact, including sub-millisecond differences. No packet schema or opcode changes.

**Missing behavior and limitations**

- Terrain obstruction, full swept moving-world collision, gravity, turn-limited homing, moving skill objects and official visual synchronization remain open. Launch-snapshot ray/capsule selection and impact occupancy are a bounded local model.
- Piercing/multiple contacts per flight are not implemented. PS2C_ServerProjectileHitNoti is not produced. Validated client updates drive PS2C_UpdateProjectileNoti with the server-calculated destination; client hit reports remain confirmation only and cannot add or accelerate damage.
- The captured player ProjectileHitNoti also lists the caster in target_datas (apparently for self-targeted hit effects); only the struck unit is listed. The client socket and animation adjustment of server-driven launch points is not modelled.
- Original-client observation of the corrected player and monster projectiles has not been recorded yet.
- Homing paths and the original client's acceptance of server-calculated projectile updates are unobserved.
- Area stickToGround is not modelled (no server terrain height): offset areas keep the caster's height, while captured official areas sat 0.1-1.1 m from the reported caster height on slopes. EX5TargetingPosType_Aim (effect 165003) and MainTarget areas cast without a target still fall back to the caster.
- Elemental Staff follow-ups: the official no-target placement and the client's aim_position were never captured, so the report wait and the at-range fallback are Candidate; the new placement log lines record what the live client sends. maxSpawnCount is treated as an upper bound (the one captured multi-spawn projectile, 140816 with limit 4, spawned once per event in 12 of 12), so Dragon's Roar keeps one flight per release. Lifetime-end effects of client-driven flights and the official LifeTime (not HitStatic) behaviour are unverified. Status stack counts are not simulated.
- Retained action immunity does not establish general projectile rollback safety, historical shield activation or positions, or overdue flights created after action retirement. Native ordered scheduling and retained quest settlement are now connected, but transient encounter state and uncommitted RAM batches are not reconstructed after process restart. Unknown producer outcomes retain their owner and admission fence instead of being replayed.
- The historical raw research artifacts previously linked here are no longer present in this checkout after workspace cleanup. Existing historical findings are retained as recorded evidence, not newly reproduced analysis.

**Evidence and verification**

Captured official behavior: every local-player SpawnProjectileNoti in the tutorial, P1, P2 and A1 world captures echoes a client 20012 projectile instance (58/42/183/10); 15 of 15 SpawnClientProjectileFailNoti answer a 20012 22-74 ms later; server-timed NPC hits are DamageNoti, ProjectileHitNoti, DespawnProjectileNoti(HitTarget). Static recovery: the opcode-40 client handler 0x145F302F0 (saved as AAC_Projectile_OnSpawnProjectileNoti_ConfirmOrCreate) confirms a pending local flight keyed by (caster, low 32-bit instance) only when skill instance and effect unique id match, otherwise it creates a separate flight. No original-client acceptance was observed for this change. M1 mage capture (2026-10-26): Mage barrage 2215 emits projectile types 160554/160555/160556 in two casts; 160555/160556 are new to this corpus. Effect IDs differ from projectile IDs. Spawn timing does not establish collision, flight time, AOE or continued damage ownership. W1 Wavesword capture (2026-10-26): W1 has no own spawn-projectile report. New projectile type 100200 belongs to a nearby item action 1002; five other spawns belong to the rifle NPC. Wavesword command reports include dummy spawnAreaOfEffect effect 211804; a complete area-damage lifecycle is unproven. Local rework 2026-10-26 adds free aim, off-path arrow exclusion, splash target selection, unique event IDs, early-report deadline enforcement and grouped area-pulse regression cases. Updated test name: AClientMissWithdrawsItsFlightAndFreeAimCanHitAnEnemyOnTheFlightPath. Current validation and explicit physics/live limits are recorded in docs/combat-rework-20261026.md. Verified local rework: Release server/tests build; focused C++ 159 cases (151 passed, eight historical-profile gates skipped, zero failed), including 16 movement-vitals integration regressions; the TLS combat/potion case passes only with the documented child-process OPENSSL_ia32cap=0 diagnostic and reproduces the known nonvolatile-pointer crash with normal CPU dispatch, including 12 real-profile NPC/distance scenarios and rotated-box targeting. See docs/combat-rework-20261026.md. No original-client trial before deployment. See docs/received-packet-features-20261029.md. Lightning line area placement (2026-10-30): a user-observed original-client report showed Lightning Blast strikes all landing under the character. Across the seven official captures 70 own Caster-anchored areas (effects 160257/160258/160259/160273/160274 of skill 2266 and 211804) lie at the reported caster position plus offsetX x 10 mm along the reported yaw, within 1 mm forward and sideways, with area yaw equal to the cast yaw. **Payload fields and packet-specific runtime limits**

- **`PC2S_ExecuteSpawnProjectileSkillEffectReq`** — Validated against the running action, stage event, launch distance, maxSpawnCount and unused client instances; a client-driven flight is confirmed with SpawnProjectileNoti and its hit is scheduled by the server. Server-driven reports are not answered. M1 evidence: M1 supplies Mage barrage and elemental projectile report timing; effect IDs and projectile IDs remain separate namespaces. Rework: accepted events are single-use per cast/stage/unique event and cannot accelerate authored deadlines. Free aim may select a ray/capsule contact; linear shots exclude off-path reported targets. Full terrain/physics and live visuals remain unverified. Native shared-population requests now enter the ordered combat schedule before processing and use their admitted logical tick (2026-11-02); earlier action/projectile deadlines cannot be overtaken by a later request. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:tick (sfixed64); 2:skill_instance_id (uint32); 3:pos (x5.pb.WorldPos); 4:rotation (x5.cms.Rotation); 5:skill_effect (x5.pb.ExecuteSpawnProjectileSkillEffect)
- **`PC2S_ClientProjectileHitReq`** — Validated confirmation only, with a separate report budget; server deadlines own hits and damage. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:elapsed_time_milli (int32); 2:instance_id (int64); 3:hit (x5.pb.SkillObjectHit)
- **`PC2S_DespawnClientProjectileReq`** — Echoed once for a flight the client launched; a reported miss withdraws that flight's pending server hit. It never adds or accelerates a hit. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:despawn_projectile (x5.pb.DespawnProjectile)
- **`PC2S_UpdateProjectileReq`** — Validated against ownership, timing and the authored trajectory envelope; drives UpdateProjectileNoti. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:update_projectile (x5.pb.UpdateProjectile)
- **`PS2C_SpawnProjectileNoti`** — Echo of the client's flight for client-driven player projectiles; server-numbered launch from the catalog spawn offset (Candidate) for server-driven monster flights. M1 evidence: M1 first observes projectile types 160555/160556; 2215 has three distinct projectile types per cast in two casts. Rework preserves skill instance and unique effect identity on server flights as well as client confirmations. No duplicate server copy of a client-driven flight is emitted. Original-client acceptance remains pending. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:caster_unit_id (uint64); 2:spawn_projectile (x5.pb.SpawnProjectile)
- **`PS2C_SpawnClientProjectileFailNoti`** — One notification per named flight of a refused client spawn report. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:instance_id (int64)
- **`PS2C_ProjectileHitNoti`** — Sent after the hit effects of a server-timed impact with the struck unit only; the caster entry seen in captured player hits is not reproduced. Rework follows server-deadline impact effects after ray/capsule selection and linear impact-occupancy validation. Piercing and full terrain/continuous collision remain missing. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:caster_unit_id (uint64); 2:instance_id (int64); 3:target_datas (repeated x5.pb.ProjectileHitTargetData)
- **`PS2C_ServerProjectileHitNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:caster_unit_id (uint64); 2:target_datas (repeated x5.pb.ProjectileHitTargetData)
- **`PS2C_DespawnProjectileNoti`** — Echo of the client's despawn for client flights; HitTarget/LifeTime/SkillStageCancel for server-driven flights. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:caster_unit_id (uint64); 2:despawn_projectile (x5.pb.DespawnProjectile)
- **`PS2C_DespawnSkillObjectNoti`** — LifeTime despawn of a server-spawned area of effect at the end of its SkillObject duration, followed by its unit removal 1496 ms later, as observed for the official poison-bottle cloud. Other despawn reasons are not produced. Area unit ids fit the client's 32-bit unit lookup (block 0xD0000000, type nibble 3). Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:reason_type (x5.cms.EX5SkillObjectDespawnReasonType)
- **`PS2C_UpdateProjectileNoti`** — Published to observers with the server-calculated destination or lost state after a valid client update. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:update_projectile (x5.pb.UpdateProjectile)
- **`PS2C_RaycastRes`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:hit_pos (x5.pb.WorldPos); 2:start_pos (x5.pb.WorldPos)

## Status effects, recovery, auras and abnormal gauges

**Feature status: PARTIAL.**

Buff/debuff add/update/remove, shields, auras, healing, regeneration and abnormal buildup.

**Current implementation**

- Combat has bounded transient vitals and recovery definitions; basic stat-change output exists.
- PARTIAL, self-cast timed status only: a skill whose effect adds a catalog status (507 duration rows, 70 skill references, loaded from an optional combat.status_effects profile table) sends PS2C_AddStatusEffectNoti (opcode 49) with the catalog duration and one PS2C_RemoveStatusEffectNoti (opcode 51) at expiry; when the player dies each active status is removed with one opcode 51 at the death tick and revive emits none. Death-removal timing (the official removal came 98 ms to 1.4 s after the death) and self-versus-monster generalisation are Candidate. Without the profile table the loader accepts the profile and no status is applied. Native tests ran with a profile carrying the table; no stacking, refresh, stat, damage, random-effect, aura or NPC claims, and no original-client acceptance.
- PARTIAL, item recoveries and status stat modifiers (docs/item-use.md): a statRecovery effect announces the official flow, StatSyncNoti (54, SCS_StatRecoveryFlow, rate per second, start/end tick, checkpoint) then AddStatRecoveryNoti (80, effect and StatRecovery cms id), as in 22 of 22 official potion drinks; the server then adds the same gain silently in proportion to elapsed time, capped at the maximum and scaled by PotionHealRate (stat 91, per mille) when the catalog row asks for it. A self-cast status whose StatusEffect.FK_maintainEffects resolve to MaintainStat rows adds their flat statAdd values with one ChangeStatNoti (47, SCS_StatusEffect, changed stats then the clamped current HP/SP) before 49 and reverts them with 47 before 51, matching 3 of 3 official adds and 3 of 4 removals of status 100597; active modifiers survive equipment stat refreshes. Re-adding an active ResetDuration status refreshes its expiry with UpdateStatusEffectNoti (50, same instance), as the captured 2001005 refresh did. A self-cast removeStatusEffect removes the player's statuses of that id. Candidate: an EndSkillStage recovery stops when its casting action ends early, sent as the same flow without a rate (no official cancelled recovery was captured). Synthetic CombatItemUse tests only; no original-client acceptance.
- PARTIAL ailment gauges, multipliers and monster statuses (docs/item-effects.md): GameVariable gauge rules (maximum 20000, per-type decay every 100 ms, ailment status 12 to 18) drive PS2C_ChangeAbnormalStatusGaugeNoti (52) with the value at its update tick, as observed (the captured Bleeding 10256 decayed to 9632 after 1341 ms); a filled gauge is reported empty before its ailment status. Damage effects' abnormalStatus*Attack raise the target's gauge by a Candidate 1.7 x attack (median of eight official gains, 1.51 to 2.50); addAbnormalGauge effects change gauges directly (cures lower them); statuses whose Immune row names a type block its gains. MaintainStat.statMul applies in 1/1000 percent, the unit the client tooltip AAC_PerkNode_FormatStatDescription (0x146253490) displays (add first, then multiplier: Candidate order). Statuses also apply to monsters (a player's addStatusEffect on a monster, a damage effect's FK_statusEffectId, ailments) with 49/50/51 naming the monster; Stacking statuses are refreshed rather than stacked (Candidate). Synthetic CombatItemEffects tests.
- Movement vitals now gate natural SP recovery during sprint/swim and natural HP recovery underwater. Shared-map sessions advance the same player regen/status-expiry path without private NPC simulation; surfacing/rest resumes existing SPRegen stat 25 and HPRegen stat 15 on the preserved one-second cadence. See docs/movement-vitals.md for local policy, official-timing limits and verified cases.

**Missing behavior and limitations**

- Aura membership, shields/grabs, ailment damage over time, Stacking stack counts, random effects, NPC self-buffs and status group removal are not simulated.
- The ailment gauge gain per attack point is a Candidate median (official gains 1.51 to 2.50 x attack); the order of statAdd and statMul is unproven.
- The historical raw research artifacts previously linked here are no longer present in this checkout after workspace cleanup. Existing historical findings are retained as recorded evidence, not newly reproduced analysis.

A positive healed amount is not established. New status 2000000 is also on a nearby player; one stack-1/20 s add does not establish its stacking lifecycle. Movement-vitals extraction preserves the existing combat regen/status-expiry order and fall damage contract. Current isolated checks pass 32/32 focused cases and 91 Combat regressions with 14 optional-environment skips; no new PostgreSQL or original-client acceptance is asserted. Source layout move (phase 1a of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-modular-emulator-architecture-design.md): every src/ file moved into its module folder listed in tools/source_layout.json; only includes, src/CMakeLists.txt source paths and src/ path references changed. No packet, persistence or gameplay behavior changed. Checks: Release build, the full CTest run with the same test names and results as before the move (including the registered Python smoke tests), and tools/test_move_sources.py. Follow-up hardening preserves every gameplay, packet, persistence and ordering contract: the world request IDs shared by the frame pipeline, native world and owning features are defined once in world/core/world_request_opcodes.hpp with unchanged values, frame-pipeline route sets for loot, revival, housing, chat, companion/trade, item use, company, equipment, progression, merchant, processing, gathering, utility bag and private combat are asserted across the whole 16-bit opcode range, the full pipeline step order is pinned by literal traces, native world statically ties its credential slice sizes to the transport constants, and party, gathering and guild report once (spdlog error) when a non-empty update is dropped because no delivery is installed. **Payload fields and packet-specific runtime limits**

- **`PC2S_EnterAuraUnitsReq`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:instance_id (uint64); 2:tick (sfixed64); 3:pos (x5.pb.WorldPos); 4:enter_unit_ids (repeated uint64)
- **`PS2C_HealNoti`** — First observed once in W1 for a nearby LongSword user's damage-linked self-heal shape, paired with effect 111211. No positive healed amount, general lifesteal formula or current HealNoti-producing runtime path was established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:skill_effect_cms_id (int32); 4:caster_unit_id (uint64); 5:target_unit_id (uint64); 6:tick (sfixed64); 7:stat_changes (repeated x5.pb.StatChange)
- **`PS2C_ChangeStatNoti`** — Current server-owned tutorial combat/AI path, equipment and tempering refreshes, and carried-weight encumbrance (stat 84 MoveSpeedRate with default_source SCS_StatusEffect). Exact mechanics, general effects and shared world remain open. Vehicle health changes (SCS_Damage, SCS_InteractionFlow). Movement drain uses SCS_SprintFlow or SCS_SwimFlow on shared stamina stat 72. Natural movement recovery reuses SPRegen stat 25; natural HP/SP recovery is gated underwater/while exerting. Swimming also announces a continuous SCS_SwimFlow with StatSyncNoti; server-side spending remains authoritative. Original-client interpolation and acceptance remain unverified. Shield grants report stat 71 with SCS_StatusEffect before the shield status; expiry and dispel report stat 71 cleared. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:tick (sfixed64); 4:stat_changes (repeated x5.pb.StatChange); 5:default_source (x5.pb.EStatChangeSource)
- **`PS2C_AddStatusEffectNoti`** — Emitted for self-cast skill status effects with a catalog duration (src/world/features/combat/combat.cpp) and for the carried-weight encumbrance tiers, which are permanent (expire_tick INT64_MAX, as observed for catalog-durationless statuses). Stacking rules other than ResetDuration, per-unit creation, curse fields and the pos field are not produced. The player escape adds its hidden cooldown 50030003 (300 s catalog duration) and the teleport invincibility 50030002 (INT64_MAX). Also emitted for statuses on monsters (debuffs and ailments) and for ailment statuses on the player. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:status_effect (x5.pb.StatusEffect); 3:pos (x5.pb.WorldPos)
- **`PS2C_UpdateStatusEffectNoti`** — Sent only when an active self-cast ResetDuration status is applied again: same instance, new start and expiry, as in the captured 2001005 refresh. Stack-count updates are not simulated. Stacking statuses (the balm debuff) are refreshed the same way (Candidate). Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:tick (sfixed64); 3:status_effects (repeated x5.pb.StatusEffect)
- **`PS2C_RemoveStatusEffectNoti`** — Emitted when a self-cast status expires, is removed or is cleared on death (src/world/features/combat/combat.cpp), and when a carried-weight encumbrance tier ends. Partial stack removal, group removal and the curse field are not produced. The player escape removes 50030002 after its teleport and 50030003 at the cooldown expiry. Monster statuses are removed at expiry. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:tick (sfixed64); 3:status_effects (repeated x5.pb.RemoveStatusEffect)
- **`PS2C_ChangeAbnormalStatusGaugeNoti`** — Player and monster ailment gauges: value at its update tick (the client decays it), omitted when a filled gauge resets before its ailment status, as observed. The gain per attack point is Candidate. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:gauges (repeated x5.pb.AbnormalStatusGauge)
- **`PS2C_StatSyncNoti`** — Emitted for the player's death regen checkpoint and for statRecovery flows (SCS_StatRecoveryFlow with rate, start/end tick and checkpoint), matching 22 of 22 official potion drinks. Candidate: an early-ended EndSkillStage recovery is stopped with the same flow instance without a rate. Sprint flows are not emitted. Gathering emits the captured SCS_InteractionFlow SP drain with its regen range before StartInteractionAnimNoti; a cancelled gather stops it with the flow instance and no rate (Candidate). Swimming also sends the captured SCS_SwimFlow start/stop and regeneration checkpoints; synthetic and TLS validation only. Candidate swimming flow tests are synthetic; matching original-client behavior remains unverified. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:flows (repeated x5.pb.StatSyncNoti.Flow); 3:regens (repeated x5.pb.StatSyncNoti.Regen); 4:tick (sfixed64)
- **`PS2C_AddStatRecoveryNoti`** — Sent after the recovery flow with the effect id and StatRecovery cms id, start/end tick and per-second value, matching 22 of 22 official potion drinks; synthetic tests only, no original-client acceptance. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:skill_effect_id (int32); 2:unit_id (uint64); 3:stat_recovery (x5.pb.StatRecovery)
- **`PS2C_RemoveStatRecoveryNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: Empty protobuf body.
- **`PS2C_AttachAuraNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:aura_id (int32); 2:unit_id (uint64); 3:expire_tick (sfixed64)
- **`PS2C_AttachAuraSuccessRes`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:skill_effect_id (int32); 2:instance_id (uint64); 3:holder_id (uint64); 4:expire_tick (sfixed64); 5:entered_unit_ids (repeated uint64)
- **`PS2C_AttachAuraFailRes`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:ec (x5.ec.EErrorCode); 2:skill_effect_id (int32)
- **`PS2C_EnterAuraUnitsSuccessRes`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:instance_id (uint64); 2:enter_success_unit_ids (repeated uint64)
- **`PS2C_EnterAuraUnitsFailRes`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:ec (x5.ec.EErrorCode); 2:instance_id (uint64)
- **`PS2C_LeaveAuraUnitNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:instance_id (uint64); 2:leave_unit_id (uint64)

## Level, EXP, stats, perks and achievements

**Feature status: PARTIAL.**

Character snapshots, leveling, allocated stats, perks, expertise, zones and achievements.

**Current implementation**

- Persisted EXP, initial character metadata and catalog-derived four-class equipment stats exist.
- Core/equipment rating curves and limits are implemented for supported unmodified item state.
- Cumulative EXP and automatic level-up (src/world/features/character/progression.cpp): CharacterLevel.nextLevelExp is the cumulative total that reaches the next level; one award can cross several levels; the level-40 cap row is a sentinel that is never reached. Each reached level grants CharacterLevel.charBuildPoint (3) LevelUpPoints, and unspent points carry over.
- EXP sources: tutorial quest rewards and adventure objects (scaled by the operator rate) and combat-established tutorial monster kills. Kill EXP uses a Candidate fit, round_half_up((5 + npc_level / 4) * grade) with Weak 0.4, Normal 1, Strong 1.6, Elite 16 and Boss_B 60, that reproduces every captured kill; unobserved boss grades reuse 60 as emulator policy.
- Attribute allocation: UpdateStatBonusReq spends LevelUpPoints as deltas on Con/Dex/End/Int/Str/Tal with StatBonus_* refusals, replies ChangeStatBonusNoti, CombatWeaponGaugeNoti and ChangeStatNoti (SCS_Equip), and CharacterStats adds the bonuses before every derived formula.
- Perks (weapon traits): ChangePerkReq activates or deactivates earned PerkNode nodes of the character's class for PerkNode.cost WeaponPoints, validating class, cost type, level, auto-registration, any-of prerequisites over the whole resulting tree and exclusive groups with the recovered PerkNode_* codes; ChangePerkRes echoes packet_index and both balances; observers receive UnitPerkNoti. ResetPerkReq refunds one theme and replies ResetPerkNoti. Earned Stat perks add their flat statAdd to character stats.
- World entry sends WorldCharPerkNoti with auto-registered plus earned nodes and both build point balances. A level-up refills a living player's HP/SP, refreshes the cached player nub and party identity, and sends ChangeCharacterPublicNoti to observers.
- Persistence (migration version 20): level, LevelUpPoints, WeaponPoints, the six attribute bonuses and tombstoned perk rows commit with the character revision in memory and PostgreSQL stores. Characters saved before automatic level-up are reconciled once at world entry. Tutorial quest CharBuildPoint rewards are generated and granted.
- GM progression commands for game-master handoffs: exp_up, set_level, add/set_char_build_point, reset_stat_bonus and force_reset_perk (text and structured GmCmd).
- Operator EXP rate: quest-reward and adventure-object EXP are scaled by the console's base rate plus active scheduled bonus events (0-1000%, saturating). The default 100% leaves every catalog amount unchanged.
- Item tempering (polish) scales every curve-based equipment term (attack, armor and elemental, any slot) and every basic-stat bonus by (1 + ItemPolishIncreaseValue percent / 100), matching the client's AAC_Equipment_Calculate* and AAC_Equipment_CalculateBasicStatBonus (static evidence); fixed hit/impact terms are not scaled, and a step outside the item's increase table adds nothing, as in the client. Step 0 leaves every result bit-identical. Observed: only the equipped-weapon physical/magic attack frames; armor, elemental and basic-stat polish values are unobserved.
- Nui offerings use the statically recovered ItemUseReq 20077 sender rather than an invented blessing request. The bounded runtime requires item 2000, an indexed nearby statue target, a positive owned-stack count, no quick-slot/nonzero instance selector and living/nonbusy state. A revision-guarded transaction spends tears and advances incremental NuiBlessingLevel thresholds; duplicate sequences cannot spend twice. ItemsUpdateNoti 169 and ChangeNuiBlessingLevelNoti 74 follow commit, with SCS_Growth stat refresh when the level changes. Stored level/partial tears appear in WorldCharBaseNoti; CharacterStats applies cumulative catalog MaxHP/MaxSP rewards. The researched catalog grants 20 MaxHP per reached level through level 30; this is not a direct GM blessing-level operation.
- Graduation test kit (2026-10-28, docs/graduation-grant.md): emulator policy for the test phase. A character that enters the overworld below the level cap, and is not a game master, receives before its entry snapshots are built: every quest of the 1,571-quest catalog completed through the quest book's game-master completion (equipment that the quest book misfiles as stackables is dropped), the best-tier equipment of its class (up to three pieces per slot, 38-39 pieces), 200 health potions, 100 stamina potions, 20 repairers, the Gold cap, the level cap (40) and both build point balances at their 100,000 maximum. The level is raised last and doubles as the idempotence marker. Disabled by default; the supplied game configuration explicitly sets graduation_grant to off. Only an explicit --graduation-grant on enables this disposable-test policy. Only while explicitly enabled, a character that finishes the tutorial is told by chat to re-enter for the kit. Normal tutorial completion and world entry preserve earned levels, quests, equipment, gold and build points without automatic grants. Disabling the policy does not downgrade previously boosted characters. The stored quest record limit rose from 1,024 to 4,096 to match the quest book. Synthetic verification only.
- UpdateStateAchievementReq (20061) completes an achievement only when every authored goal reaches its threshold from stored facts and all child achievements are complete; claiming needs the stored completion receipt. Gold/Hersander token (ItemsUpdateNoti), EXP (ChangeCharacterBaseNoti) and the Rewarded state (AchievementUpdateNoti 121) commit with the world revision; repeats return the current state without paying again. Receipts persist in schema 36 and world entry sends WorldCharAchievementsNoti (143), as official entries do.
- Full-wallet achievement and box rewards (2026-11-01): CUSTOM: an achievement gold or token reward above the wallet limit fills the wallet and the achievement is marked rewarded (it previously stayed unclaimable for graduated characters); draw-box money above the limit is dropped and the box still opens, reporting the credited amount.
- Authored Coilstone interactions can grant their configured trait build points once after their conditions are met; leveling continues to grant its separate stat points. Exported levels grant LevelUpPoint; 609 PerkNode rows cost WeaponPoint. Those data do not establish a WeaponPoint grant on every level.

**Missing behavior and limitations**

- Some shared-world trait reward sources and their original-client behavior remain unverified. Monster kills made before their play records were tracked cannot be reconstructed automatically.
- Perk effects other than flat Stat nodes (skill unlocks, skill action layers, theme abilities, skill costs) are stored and reported but not applied by server combat; kill EXP for unobserved grades, deactivation refunds and theme reset behavior are Candidates.
- Achievements, expertise progression, zone completion, play records and world-level services remain unestablished. Nui blessing now has a bounded offering/persistence/stat path; original-client UI/reward acceptance and direct GM level assignment remain unverified or unavailable.
- Item options/sockets, durable current vitals and active weapon persistence need integration; the item tempering request is covered under inventory. Rates and scheduled events are emulator policy, not a recovered official event service.
- Graduation test kit limits: it is not official behavior and no skill is learned automatically (the points are granted, the player spends them). Game master accounts and characters already at the level cap are never granted; items removed later are not restored. Original-client display of a 1,571-entry quest list, of the level-cap character and of the tier-80 gear is not observed; the items' stored tier exceeds the level cap and equipability by the client is unverified.
- Achievement goals are evaluated only for character level, quest completion counts and specific adventure objects. PlayRecord counters (318 goal rows), adventure counts by zone, weighted logbook percentage, expertise level and player kills are refused with their achievement error until the server records those facts.

Current candidate synthetic TLS tests with the quest catalog deliberately absent exercised one monster EXP award across reconnect and lost-acknowledgement level recovery; the latter also passed with isolated PostgreSQL and a fault proxy. Client progression data and a monster profile were present; an entirely absent client catalog was not tested. Fresh split-service installation trial (2026-11-03): the researched compatible private client accepted the corrected login fingerprint, entered tutorial map 8000 through separate login/game processes and displayed health/stamina after the private catalog and tutorial/combat profile were loaded. Weapon actions (CMS 1000000 and 1101), root-motion updates and continued keepalives were observed; the guarded local helper restored both temporary changes. Missing data had allowed map rendering with incomplete stats/actions. This bounded local trial does not establish full tutorial, damage/recovery, all skills, hosted or stock-client compatibility. See docs/fresh-install-validation-20261103.md. Normal progression default 2026-11-03: server option defaults to graduation disabled and the example configuration explicitly sets off. Character/progression executable: 71 passed, nine existing environment-gated skips, zero failed. No player data downgrade or new original-client gameplay acceptance is claimed.

**Payload fields and packet-specific runtime limits**

- **`PC2S_ChangePerkReq`** — Activates/deactivates earned perk nodes for WeaponPoints with prerequisite, exclusive-group, cost and PerkNode_* validation and persistence. Only flat Stat perk effects reach server stats; skill-unlock effects are not applied by server combat. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:packet_index (int32); 2:updated_perks (repeated x5.pb.PerkData)
- **`PC2S_ResetPerkReq`** — Candidate: refunds every earned node of the requested theme; no official reset was captured. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:theme_type (x5.cms.EX5PerkNodeThemeType)
- **`PC2S_UpdateStatBonusReq`** — Spends LevelUpPoints as deltas on Con..Tal with StatBonus_* refusals (CommonErrorRes, Candidate), commits with the character revision and refreshes stats; tutorial and shared-map sessions. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:stats (repeated x5.pb.UpdateStatBonusReq.Stat)
- **`PC2S_UpdateStateAchievementReq`** — Completion from stored facts for level, quest count and adventure-object goals; claims pay once. Other goal kinds are refused. Schema file: `p_c2s.proto`. Fields: 1:cms_id (int32); 2:achievement_state (x5.cms.EX5AchievementState)
- **`PS2C_ChangeCharacterBaseNoti`** — Observed shapes: exp-only gains, exp plus level and LevelUpPoint balance on a level change, and WeaponPoint-only grants; emitted for tutorial quest, adventure-object and kill EXP, quest CharBuildPoint rewards and GM commands. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:level (uint32); 2:exp (int64); 3:remaining_char_build_points (repeated x5.pb.ChangeCharacterBaseNoti.RemainingCharBuildPointsEntry); 4:pk_bonus_exp (int64)
- **`PS2C_ChangeCharacterPublicNoti`** — Sent to presence observers when the character's level changes. Private tutorial sessions have no observers, so it is only reachable from shared-map sessions (GM level changes); original-client display is unverified. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:level (uint32)
- **`PS2C_ChangeAdventureExpNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:level (uint32); 2:exp (int64)
- **`PS2C_ChangeWorldLevelNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:world_level (uint32)
- **`PS2C_ChangeNuiBlessingLevelNoti`** — Emitted after a committed indexed-statue tear offering with stored level and partial dedicated_nui_tears; catalog incremental thresholds and cumulative stat rewards are supported statically. No official offering/74 sequence or original-client UI acceptance was observed; synthetic test sources only. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:level (uint32); 2:dedicated_nui_tears (int32)
- **`PS2C_CharPlayRecordUpdateNoti`** — An authored monster kill record is sent after its server-side count increases; other record kinds remain partial. Synthetic checks only. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:play_record (x5.pb.PlayRecord)
- **`PS2C_ChangePerkRes`** — Echoes packet_index with both build point balances; refusals carry the PerkNode_* ec and unchanged balances. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:packet_index (int32); 2:ec (x5.ec.EErrorCode); 3:remaining_char_build_points (repeated x5.pb.ChangePerkRes.RemainingCharBuildPointsEntry)
- **`PS2C_ResetPerkNoti`** — Candidate reply to ResetPerkReq and GM force_reset_perk with both balances; unobserved. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:remaining_char_build_points (repeated x5.pb.ResetPerkNoti.RemainingCharBuildPointsEntry)
- **`PS2C_UnitPerkNoti`** — Sent to presence observers after a committed perk change or reset; the shape matches frames captured for other players, own-unit delivery is not used. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:unit_id (uint64); 2:perks (repeated x5.pb.PerkData)
- **`PS2C_ChangeStatBonusNoti`** — Observed reply carrying the LevelUpPoint balance, followed by CombatWeaponGaugeNoti and ChangeStatNoti (SCS_Equip). Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:remaining_char_build_points (repeated x5.pb.ChangeStatBonusNoti.RemainingCharBuildPointsEntry)
- **`PS2C_AchievementUpdateNoti`** — Sent after a committed completion or reward claim and for repeated requests. Schema file: `p_s2c.proto`. Fields: 1:achievement (x5.pb.AchievementData)
- **`PS2C_WorldCharBaseNoti`** — Persisted level, cumulative EXP, Nui blessing level and partial dedicated tears; world_level remains fixed. gm=true is sent for game-master handoffs. Blessing snapshots and cumulative rewards have synthetic source checks; original-client acceptance remains unverified. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 1:char_id (sfixed64); 2:name (string); 3:char_class (x5.cms.EX5CharacterClass); 4:level (uint32); 5:exp (int64); 6:world_level (uint32); 7:nui_blessing_level (uint32); 8:dedicated_nui_tears (int32); 9:gm (bool)
- **`PS2C_WorldCharExpertiseSkillsNoti`** — World entry lists all sixteen expertise types at Lv1, the official new-character snapshot; the client needs a non-zero level to open a crafting station. Expertise experience and level-ups are not persisted or updated. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 2:skills (repeated x5.pb.DbExpertiseSkill)
- **`PS2C_CharExpertiseSkillsUpdateNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 1:skills (repeated x5.pb.DbExpertiseSkill)
- **`PS2C_WorldCharPlayRecordNoti`** — Saved nonempty monster play records are sent at shared-world entry. Original-client acceptance is pending. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 1:play_records (repeated x5.pb.PlayRecord)
- **`PS2C_WorldCharPerkNoti`** — World entry lists auto-registered and persisted earned nodes with both build point balances. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 1:perks (repeated x5.pb.PerkData); 2:remaining_char_build_points (repeated x5.pb.WorldCharPerkNoti.RemainingCharBuildPointsEntry)
- **`PS2C_WorldCharZonesNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 2:zones (repeated x5.pb.Zone)
- **`PS2C_CharZonesUpdateNoti`** — No current runtime path established. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 1:zones (repeated x5.pb.Zone)
- **`PS2C_WorldCharAchievementsNoti`** — World-entry snapshot of stored completion and reward receipts. Schema file: `p_s2c.character.proto`. Fields: 1:achievements (repeated x5.pb.AchievementData)

## Quest chains, objectives and rewards

**Feature status: PARTIAL.**

Acceptance, progress, hunt receipts, reward, abandon and job boards.

**Current implementation**

- Seven map-8000 and two followup quest definitions support bounded triggers/dialogue/doodad/hunt objectives.
- Atomic revisioned rewards, supplies, objective counters and exactly-once kill receipts persist.
- Synthetic persistence regression GeneratedQuests.ShadowsOfMemoryStaysPendingUntilAllThreeObjectivesAndRetriesNeverResetIt: the generated Shadows of Memory quest stays pending until all three objectives are done and re-entering or retrying never resets it. This is a native fixture test, not original-client progress, not PostgreSQL proof, and not evidence about sector streaming.
- tools/build_quest_catalog.py normalizes all 1,571 client quests (1,586 rows; class-variant rows merged) into data/generated/quests/catalog.json with objective groups, placed trigger geometry tagged by world asset, fixed rewards, sequential successors and explicit unsupported reasons. 825 have no unsupported requirement; 132 of those also need kill or doodad events. Server-owned shared-world monster defeats can advance HuntMonster objectives; InteractDoodad progression remains incomplete outside tutorial instances.
- src/world/features/quests/world_quests.cpp (WorldQuestBook) serves AcceptQuestReq, ProgressQuestReq, QuestRewardReq, DialogueStartReq and DialogueEndReq on every non-tutorial map: NPC/trigger/predecessor/level acceptance, Quest and CheckUnitLevel conditions, trigger enter/leave, dialogue selection, InteractNpc, GetItem, CharLevelUp, EquipItem and AdventureObjectStatus objectives, NPC turn-in, supplies, gold/item/EXP rewards and automatic sequential successors. It evaluates against the tracked position, the session's announced units and stored progress, and commits the revision before publishing. Unsupported acceptance, conditions, rewards or completions fail closed.
- Shared-world entry sends WorldCharQuestsNoti (136) once with every saved quest.
- Quest rules shared by both paths live in src/world/features/quests/quest_rules.cpp (objective groups, sequential readiness, grouped quest conditions, trigger geometry, rewards).
- World monsters (2026-10-26): shared authoritative populations export 2,802 slots on 106 populated maps (196 definitions), including 417 on 9012 and 812 on 9031, with 470 authored patrols and 1,893 actions. Public clients share health, aggro/action ownership, damage, death and respawn. Raid channels use independent populations keyed by actual channel ID. Current-pose sight, bounded visual journals, fresh life IDs, one-time slots, corpse expiry, killer-owned loot, server HuntMonster credit and EXP are wired. GM test NPCs remain private. See docs/world-mobs.md. Catalog Instance maps use per-character monster populations; party-instance admission remains unrecovered.
- World-mob correction (2026-10-26): typed wire identities now fit 32 bits because client MoveNoti actor lookup clears the high dword. Separate server-only random receipt IDs preserve durable HuntMonster credit. Roaming-enabled pathless NPCs get bounded local idle walks (687 slots, including 163 on map 9012 and all 21 Meadow Wolf slots); authored patrols remain distinct. Combat/return/death/GM pause suspend walks, and fresh lives reset at home. Explicit player skill targets use the live/attackable/private-ownership predicate. See docs/world-mobs.md.
- InteractNpc and dialogue objectives can target client-owned static NPCs on the Shining Shore channels through the static interaction index, for example quest 10000134 (Way of the Hunt, Herlei 1001600 on map 9012). The hosted map 9012 previously had no static targets, so the dialogue was refused before the objective could be credited.
- Quest coverage repair (2026-10-29): CUSTOM inactive monster spawners whose monster is a QuestProgress HuntMonster target stay present (quest_target_activation), so 25 more hunt objective references (22 in otherwise fully supported quests) are reachable. WorldQuestBook turn-in is now blocked only by an unmodeled completion mechanic (job board, doodad); unmodeled reward kinds (CompanyContribution, GuildExp, Intimate, Mate, CharBuildPoint, CompanyLevelUnlock, random loot packs) are omitted while the catalog's gold/item/EXP rewards are paid, so regional quest chains continue. Every playable map now has its civilians and static targets for NpcId acceptance, InteractNpc and NPC turn-in.
- Quest objective audit (2026-10-30): WorldQuestBook now also serves InteractMemo, CounterSuccessCrafting, CounterTryCrafting, EtherealHuntMonster (named NPC) and EtherealInteractDoodad. Captured official flows: Words of Warning (10000189) reported ProgressQuestReq.interact_memo{memo_cms_id 10000127, spot_object_id of the Zone_01_Public_02 board}; Pioneer's Remedy (10000126) got QuestUpdateNoti right after the Lifeflow Potion craft result. build_quest_catalog.py exports every placed memo spot object (world, spot unit, centre) on InteractMemo objectives; a report must name one of them in the current world within the 7 m interaction range. Committed crafting-station recipes and gathering doodad interactions become QuestEvents that credit ready counter objectives in their own revisioned commit after the producer's commit. Ethereal virtual drops use the authored rate/minValue/maxValue (Candidate). The catalog had 854 quests without an unsupported reason (825 before); merged with the company-condition work it has 876.
- Turn-in consumes the stacks that satisfied GetItem objectives in an ItemsUpdateNoti with quest_reward{quest_cms_id} before the rewards, as captured for quests 10000096 (bone chips 6 -> 1), 10000110 and 10000125. Item instances (equipment) are not removed. ProgressQuestReq.interact_npc (captured after every DialogueStartReq for an InteractNpc objective) is validated against the announced NPC and confirms the dialogue credit instead of failing.
- Company quest conditions and level unlocks (2026-10-30): RequirementType.Company is evaluated against CompanyService in the client's order (same company, pioneer permit unless ignored, minimum level, exact capped-level ceiling for is_max_contribution, minimum contribution); without a company service it fails closed. CompanyLevelUnlock rewards apply through CompanyService::unlock_position after the completion commit and are re-applied at world entry. Donella's Blue Salt housing quests 80101045 and 20001072 are now acceptable; live logs showed 80101045 refused (AcceptQuestReq 20016, 'cannot start this quest') before.
- Company contribution rewards (2026-10-30): 152 quests carry CompanyContribution points; they are credited to the current company through CompanyService::add_contribution after the completion commits (unlocks first) with PS2C_CompanyUpdateNoti. Live evidence: Donella's hidden quest 90116021 completed without its one point, leaving a Blue Salt member capped at 1500 below the level 3 that Nivhen's rent selection requires.
- Full catalog coverage (2026-10-30): all 1,571 catalog quests load with no unsupported requirement (QuestCatalog.EveryGeneratedQuestIsSupportedAndCompletesWithItsRewards completes each one with its rewards). Job boards: PC2S_QuestJobBoardReq/PS2C_QuestJobBoardRes with three daily slots drawn per character from QuestJobBoardCategory/QuestPickGroup (CUSTOM deterministic draw), Gold paid refresh, board-doodad AcceptQuestReq.unit and QuestRewardReq.unit_id (recovered client flow AAC_QuestJobBoard_SendAcceptForBoardUnit / AAC_Quest_SendQuestRewardReqForUnit), daily repetition through PS2C_QuestAbandonRes{force}. PC2S_QuestAbandonReq abandons into a tombstone with a higher attempt (schema 37). Starts by doodad and memo units, requireGold/requireItemIds gates, OwnItem/PlayRecord/AdventureObject conditions, CUSTOM GmOnly (135 development quests) and ServerOffered (31 live quests) for starts this client build never places. Objectives TimeElapsed, CheckHp, LevelExpGain, CompanyContributionGain/Total, housingFunishing, AdventureLogbookPercentage (CUSTOM client report), CounterUseItem, UseItemInTriggerVolume, TradePayment, CounterUseSkill(Effect), AddStatusEffect, npcIds and npcGroupId hunts; 24 steps whose target is never placed and DestroyObject (test quest 9088) are CUSTOM auto_credit. Rewards: random loot packs, mates, mate intimacy, build points, GuildExp through GuildService::award_experience.
- Reachable quest targets (2026-10-30): the shared doodad engine (gathering module) exports quest and portal doodads, instant interactions answered through PC2S_InteractUnitReq/PS2C_InteractUnitRes, MapMove portals travel like zone moves, and doodads of dungeon and story worlds are placed per world. World monsters now include dungeon runtime layers and NpcGroup spawners (6,878 spawns on 204 maps); NPC placements keep roaming and unsupported-patrol NPCs standing (CUSTOM). Every live quest's NPC, monster and doodad target is either hosted or credited by the documented CUSTOM rule.
- Quest-gated world items (2026-10-30): adventure objects whose activating Use interaction has an InteractionCondition of Quest/OwnItem rows are exported with interaction_conditions and checked through WorldQuestBook::requirements_met (the acceptance evaluator) before a start or instant use; failures answer Interaction_ConditionsNotMatch. First Hunt (10000125) 'Obtain Hunting Knife' needs object 20019119 (interaction 10000135, condition quest 10000125 group 1 Progressing, loot pack 3101411 -> Hunting Knife 11200301); the object was missing from the profile, so the client's use went unanswered. A committed activation now runs the quest state refresh at once, so AdventureObjectStatus and GetItem objectives update without waiting for the next time sync.
- Full-wallet rewards and live profiles (2026-11-01): graduated characters hold the full test-kit wallet (Money limit 9,000,000,000,000,000), so every gold-paying quest turn-in was answered with BadRequest and never completed (live: quest 10000046). CUSTOM: quest, supply and adventure gold or Hersander token rewards now fill the wallet to the limit and the rest of the reward is granted (quest_rules credit_money). The live host had received the full quest catalog without the regenerated gathering (quest doodads, 750 doodad points) and NPC placement (56 maps) profiles it depends on; the deployment now ships them together. Test: QuestCatalog.FinishedAutomaticQuestIsRewardedThroughTheClientClaimWithAFullWallet.
- Equipment quest rewards (2026-11-01): rewards, supplies and rolled loot packs whose item is stored as instances (equipment, tools) were credited as stack counts the inventory cannot show. QuestsSession::commit moves them into new item rows in the same transaction (QuestsSessionContext::quests_commit_items) and the ItemsUpdateNoti lists the rows; a full bag refuses the turn-in with ItemSlotLimit. The graduation quest pass no longer deletes stored misfiled stacks (live: "World progress records cannot be removed"). Tests: QuestOwner.EquipmentSuppliesAndRewardsBecomeItemRowsInTheSameCommit and EquipmentRewardWithAFullBagIsRefusedWithoutAnyCommit.
- Cliffs of Madness chain repair: Missing Officer, Rescue Plan, Alight the Cliffs, pirate captain and Pioneers Assembly Hall follow-ups start after their captured predecessors; periodic quest refresh repairs characters stranded after those completions. The quest exporter now accepts both authored sequential-group spellings, restoring 100 sequential links in the current data. Synthetic quest-chain tests use a regenerated catalog. Three later authored QuestComplete transitions start and repair the assembly-hall follow-up, Settling a Debt after quest 10000149, and An Offer You Can't Refuse after Settling a Debt. Their automatic timing is a local candidate; all authored prerequisites remain enforced and abandoned quests are not restarted.
- HuntMonster play records are indexed independently of quest conditions, including authored NPC-group records. Kills send record updates and reconnect restores saved records; pre-fix kills without a saved record are not reconstructed.
- Current candidate monster rewards stage durable defeat receipts and use fenced reconciliation for uncertain commit outcomes and recipient credit. Definitive revision conflicts are retried with the same random state; receipt processing, close ownership and reconnect admission require final integrated review and testing.
- Current candidate supervised quest reconciliation retains admission and shutdown ownership through retry when a worker post or owner retirement fails. Receipt-backed EXP, play-record and item changes retain a readback fence after an uncertain commit acknowledgement, even when quest state itself did not change.
- When the shared-world quest catalog is absent but the client progression and monster profiles are available, the current candidate can award configured monster EXP through the receipt path; it does not reconstruct missing quest or play-record definitions.
- Combat quest events now settle at successful receive/advance/direct-item-effect boundaries before monster rewards. A captured character, progress, scalar view, copied quest book and ordered events survive preparation failures. The prepared mutation, item rows, output and stable source-bound receipt are retried without rerolling or crediting a later quest attempt. Timer and request paths share this handoff; confirmed departure suppresses obsolete owner output. Exact committed or already-processed results settle the retained ledger before retirement.

**Missing behavior and limitations**

- No original-client playthrough of job boards, abandonment, server-offered starts, quest doodads, portals or the new objective kinds; every wire shape beyond the recovered client flows is Candidate.
- The official job board draw, refresh currency, PS2C_QuestJobBoardRemoveNoti use and the repeat semantics (EX5QuestStateType Repeated) are not captured; the daily tombstone repetition is CUSTOM.
- Destructible objects are not simulated (DestroyObject is credited); dependent-item retrieval is not implemented; adventure-object interaction conditions other than supported Quest/OwnItem and PlayRecord rows (such as ConsumeItem keys and channel events) are not modelled, so those objects stay unexported; general doodad tasks other than rewards remain partial; the scoped Cliffs cannon, elite barricade and rift and air-bubble recovery effects are supported.
- World-mob fidelity is partial: inactive/time/quest/event spawners, navigation/collision, full threat/group linkage, phase conditions/chains, boss scripts, party contribution rewards and transfers remain approximations (docs/world-mobs.md).
- The Cliffs quest chain and later housing progression have not been played through on the original client. The tests do not establish complete pirate-hideout, boss, party or dungeon behavior.
- Combat quest batches are retained in the current process, not persisted as recoverable producer payloads. A crash before quest commit can lose an uncommitted transient event; persistent item consumption and its combat/quest continuation are not a joint crash-atomic transaction. A genuine progress or membership conflict remains fenced rather than being replanned against new attempts. Failure before a trustworthy snapshot or inside a producer retains raw events and admission for operator recovery. Receipts use the bounded quest-service table and its reviewed offline schema-44 compaction policy.
